en: Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river or weir in the foreground, with water cascading over a low dam. On the left bank stands a large, ornate multi‑storey building with steep roofs and gables in a late‑19th‑century European style, reflected clearly in the still water. Behind and around the building are dense trees forming a riverside park. On the right in the distance a tall, slender church spire rises above more urban buildings. The overall composition and tonality resemble an early 20th‑century landscape postcard.
